Courtney Brown Warren Named Kickstarter’s CMO
We're excited to announce that Courtney Brown Warren has been appointed as Kickstarter’s new Chief Marketing Officer.
Kickstarter Staff
17 Jul 2024
—
2 min read
We’re excited to announce that
Courtney Brown Warren
has been elevated to the role of Chief Marketing Officer for Kickstarter.
As CMO, Courtney will oversee all aspects of Kickstarter's marketing strategy, including product marketing, creative, communications, content, social, experiential, partnerships, and sponsorships. She will also oversee Kickstarter’s sales and community outreach strategy, focusing on developing integrated, full-funnel approaches that cultivate a passionate, engaged, and empowered community on our platform.
Since joining Kickstarter in April 2023, Courtney has spearheaded several successful marketing initiatives, including Kickstarter’s first-ever out-of-home campaign “
Ideas in Action
,” the Kickstarter Festival in Bed-Stuy, Brooklyn, to celebrate the
brand’s 15th anniversary
, and partnerships with
FOX’s Food Stars
, the
New York Liberty
,
and
Spotify’s Findaway Voices
.
Under her direction, one of Kickstarter’s most critical surfaces for connecting with and amplifying its community—social media—has seen impressive growth with double-digit follower growth and a 482% increase in engagement across all Kickstarter social media channels, as well as an incredible +1,386.7% increase in new subscribers on the
brand’s YouTube channel
.
“I was drawn to Kickstarter because of its story as a place where people could bring their unique, wild, weird, bold ideas to life through community-driven funding. Witnessing the power of creativity and community firsthand at Kickstarter has been incredibly inspiring. As I step into this new role as Chief Marketing Officer, I’m even more inspired than ever to engage, educate, and empower the community that has made us who we are and introduce our brand to a whole new generation of creators and backers. ”  — Courtney Brown Warren
Courtney will continue to report to
Everette Taylor, CEO of Kickstarter.
“Courtney's passion for storytelling and her proven marketing expertise have already made a mark on our brand. I’m excited to see how she continues to leverage marketing to continue to invigorate the brand and champion the voices and ideas of our creators and backers around the world. Courtney will also play a critical strategic role in the adoption of new business lines and features that will not only positively impact our users but also drive significant growth for the company.” — Everette Taylor
Courtney has over two decades of experience working with global brands across diverse industries like tech, media, entertainment, and more. Before Kickstarter, Courtney served as Twitter’s Global Head of Brand, managing a global team across go-to-market brand strategy, brand campaign management, talent, and emerging markets as well as digital, content, and editorial strategy. Prior to that, she was Head of Creative at Audible, where she launched two high-growth subscription startups and revenue streams—Audible Escape and Audible for Business.
Her resume also includes prior roles at L'Oreal, WarnerMedia (Time Inc.), and the Madison Square Garden Company.
Congratulations on your new role, Courtney!

function.description: This tool belongs to the Web Search API category. It provides functions to search the web and browse search results. Tool description: This function retrieves content from the provided URL and processes it based on the selected mode. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to fetch content from. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'.

mode.description: The mode to process the fetched content. `raw` returns the raw HTML content; `markdown` converts raw HTML content to Markdown format for better readability, using html2text; `truncate` extracts and cleans text by removing scripts, styles, and extraneous whitespace.

content.description: The processed web content as a string.
